id.description: Canonical C3 Identifier for this Cloud Resource in the format of <cluster>-<env>-<app>-<func>[-<role>]-<seq>[-<subseq>].

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in {@link #id}; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in {@link #id}; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.

role.description:
C3 role; e.g. m, w; cannot be number only.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> l

@see CloudResource#cloudRoles

seq.description:
Sequence number - should only contain numbers - it is recommended to have fixed number of digits for a
`<func>-<role>` with 0 left padding so that list of resources are naturally ordered; can be 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> 0001

@see CloudResource#cloudSeqLength

subseq.description:
Sub-sequence alphanumeric string (dot allowed)
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-t-0001-kk03
=> 001

resourceId.description: Cloud service provider generated native ID, such as vpcId and securityGroupId.

resourceSecondaryId.description: Cloud service provider generated native secondary ID, such as Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

resourceName.description: User defined name attribute managed by cloud service provider.

resourceGroupName.description: Only returns resources within the resource group given.

fullyConfigured.description:
When true, CloudResource will GET from locally persisted Config framework
When false, CloudResource will GET from remote Cloud APIs

resourceNamespace.description: resourceNamespace for K8s Resources (only those which are associated with a namespace)

external.description:
This flag indicates that this cloud resource managed by third party, C3 will not create or destroy this resource
implicitly.

onlyOk.description: Only returns resources that {@link CloudResource#isOk} return true;

attributes.description: Filter out resources by different attributes. Key is the attribute name and value is the attribute value.

filters.description: Filter out resources by different filters. Key is the field name and value is the filter value.

namespace.description: Only returns resources within the namespace given.

tags.description: Match resource tags to every Cloud Tag key and value in this list.

excludeTags.description:
Avoid matching resource tags to every Cloud Tag key and value in this list.
Note: Only currently support in K8sResource and its subtypes

tagKeys.description:
Match resources by tag key presence only (regardless of value).
Only returns resources that have ALL specified tag keys present.
Difference from {@link #tags}: this checks only key existence, not the value.
Note: Only currently supported in K8sResource and its subtypes

excludeTagKeys.description:
Exclude resources by tag key presence only (regardless of value).
Excludes resources that have ANY of the specified tag keys present.
Difference from {@link #excludeTags}: this checks only key existence, not the value.
Note: Only currently supported in K8sResource and its subtypes

limit.description:
Maximum number of resources to return.  If there are fewer resources than were requested, only those will be
returned.  If there are additional resources beyond what was requested, then
{@link CloudListResourcesResult.nextMarker} will be set.

-1 returns all.

marker.description: Value from {@link CloudListResourcesResult.nextMarker} to get more results.

region.description: Cloud region filter for this request.

accountId.description: Cloud accountId filter for this request.

listChannels.description:
Include channels in the result.
Channels include partitions, shards, etc. for various cloud message brokers.
Default is false.
